Apply a diff

Source: R/diff.R
diff_apply.Rd

Applies the edit script of d to old: kept runs come from old and inserted runs from the new that d was computed against.

Usage

diff_apply(old, d)

Arguments

old

The vector the diff was computed from, or one of the same length.

d

A zudiff object, from diff_vec().

Value

The vector d turns old into. For atomic vectors it is identical to new; for factors, it combines old's and new's levels as c() does.

Examples

old <- c("a", "b", "c")
new <- c("a", "x", "c", "d")
identical(diff_apply(old, diff_vec(old, new)), new)
#> [1] TRUE
